title: EU: Parliament approves simpler rules on CMR substances in cosmetics
summary: From lipsticks to sunscreens, the European Parliament definitively adopted legislation on Thursday, October 22, giving manufacturers more time to withdraw cosmetics containing certain hazardous substances from the market. The text, known as Omnibus VI Chemistry, reflects a political compromise reached by Parliament, the Council, and the Commission on June 17, 2026.
